# CompuX

> CompuX is an AI compute credit marketplace and financing platform.
> $1M in financing → $1.25-1.5M in compute credits (25-50% multiplier).
> OpenAI-compatible API. Drop-in replacement. Multi-provider routing.
> Three-sided marketplace: AI Startups + Compute Providers + Capital Partners.
> Layer 5 (Token Operator) in the AI compute value chain.

## Product
- https://compux.ai — Main website
- https://app.compux.ai — Dashboard (registration, API keys, usage, billing)
- https://docs.compux.ai — API documentation

## API
- Base URL: https://app.compux.ai/api
- OpenAI-compatible: change base URL and API key, existing code works
- Providers: Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (GPT), Together, Fireworks, and more
- Authentication: API keys or JWT
